div.head: Af 35.4
div.ab: Gif he hine to preoste bescyre unbundenne, mid XXX scll' gebete.
Gif he hine to preoste bescire unbundenne, mid XXX scill. gebete.
Si eum radat in presbiterum, solutum, XXX sol. emendet.
Gif he hine to preoste bescire unbundenne, mid XXX scill gebete.
If he shears him unbound as a priest,120 let him pay with 30 shillings.
If he cuts his hair after the fashion of a priest's without binding him, he shall pay 30 shillings compensation.
If, without binding him, he cuts his hair like a priest’s, he is to pay him 30 shillings compensation.
Wenn er ihn zum Priester, ungefesselt, schert, büsse er mit 30 Schill.
If he shaves him like a priest, without binding him, let him pay 30 shillings.
